使用 Krea 2 Muse 在几秒钟内创建清晰的肖像和令人惊叹的场景。

适合谁：希望在 ComfyUI 中使用此管道而无需从头开始组装节点的创建者。不适合：零调整的一键结果 - 您仍然可以选择输入、提示和设置。

在 RunComfy 上打开预加载的工作流程

在 RunComfy（浏览器）上打开预加载的工作流程

为什么首先选择 RunComfy
- 更少的丢失节点意外- 在本地镜像之前，在托管环境中运行该图。
- GPU 快速试用- 如果您的本地 VRAM 或安装时间是瓶颈，则非常有用。
- 与发布的 JSON 匹配- 该 zip 遵循与您可以在 RunComfy 上打开的相同的可运行工作流程。

当下载本地 ComfyUI 有意义时- 您想要完全控制磁盘上的模型、批处理脚本或离线运行。

使用方法（本地ComfyUI）
1. 在标记的加载器节点中加载输入（图像/视频/音频）。
2、设置提示、分辨率、种子；从短暂的试运行开始。
3. 从图中所示的保存/写入节点导出。

期望- 第一次运行可能会拉动大重量;云运行可能需要免费的 RunComfy 帐户.

概述

借助 Krea 2 Muse 系统，您可以使用 Turbo FP8 检查点生成精致的肖像、风景和编辑视觉效果。其简化的节点设置合并了提示、种子、大小和采样器控件，以提高速度和创意精度。它非常适合概念艺术家、设计师和营销人员，可以跨多个作品进行快速视觉测试和探索。该工作流程通过平衡的对比度和自然光增强了视觉质量。您可以轻松地在纵向、方形或横向输出之间切换，以满足不同的创意需求。非常适合大规模制作活动模型或编辑图像。

重要节点：

Comfyui Krea 2 Muse 文本到图像 ComfyUI 工作流程中的关键节点

  • 宾源终极采样器(#6)
    中央生成器加载 Krea 2 Turbo 检查点、文本编码器和 VAE，然后在一个位置处理大小、步骤、引导、种子、采样器和调度器。使用它可以在纵向、方形和横向输出之间快速切换。保持 Krea 2 Turbo 的适度指导，在追求微观细节时增加步骤，并使用批次有效地探索多个种子。如果您应用 LoRA，请保守地调整其强度以保持基本模型的一致性。

  • CR 文本(#8)
    一个用于前缀标记的简单文本字段，应始终引导您的提示，例如样式标签、品牌标签或 LoRA 触发器。保持前缀简短并用逗号分隔，以便进行干净的调节。

  • CR 文本连接(#13)
    将前缀与主提示合并为采样器的单个格式良好的描述。使用它来强制措辞一致并测试不同的前缀如何引导相同的基本提示。

  • 种子 (rg三)(#7)
    用于生成、锁定或洗牌驱动随机性的种子值的实用程序节点。这是稍后再现图像或分支一组受控变化的最快方法。

  • binyuan多图像比较(#3)
    根据您的输出构建一个带标签的网格，以进行快速 A/B 审核。使用它用短标签注释运行，然后评估种子或参数变化的构图、照明和纹理保真度。

  • 保存图像(#20)
    使用明确的文件名前缀将渲染的图像保存到磁盘。按项目、方向或日期命名，以使大型探索井井有条。

注释

Krea 2 Muse 文本到图像 ComfyUI 工作流程 | Turbo FP8 肖像和概念艺术- 参见舒适运行页面了解最新的节点要求。

Create sharp portraits and stunning scenes in seconds with Krea 2 Muse.

Who it's for:creators who want this pipeline in ComfyUI without assembling nodes from scratch.Not for:one-click results with zero tuning - you still choose inputs, prompts, and settings.

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy (browser)

Why RunComfy first
- Fewer missing-node surprises- run the graph in a managed environment before you mirror it locally.
- Quick GPU tryout- useful if your local VRAM or install time is the bottleneck.
- Matches the published JSON- the zip follows the same runnable workflow you can open on RunComfy.

When downloading for local ComfyUI makes sense- you want full control over models on disk, batch scripting, or offline runs.

How to use (local ComfyUI)
1. Load inputs (images/video/audio) in the marked loader nodes.
2. Set prompts, resolution, and seeds; start with a short test run.
3. Export from the Save / Write nodes shown in the graph.

Expectations- First run may pulllarge weights; cloud runs may require afree RunComfy account.

Overview

With the Krea 2 Muse system, you can generate refined portraits, landscapes, and editorial visuals using the Turbo FP8 checkpoint. Its streamlined node setup merges prompts, seeds, size, and sampler controls for speed and creative precision. Ideal for concept artists, designers, and marketers, it enables quick visual testing and exploration across multiple compositions. The workflow enhances visual quality with balanced contrast and natural lighting. You can easily shift between portrait, square, or landscape outputs for diverse creative needs. Perfect for producing campaign mockups or editorial imagery at scale.

Important nodes:

Key nodes in Comfyui Krea 2 Muse text-to-image ComfyUI workflow

  • BinyuanUltimateSampler(#6)
    The central generator that loads the Krea 2 Turbo checkpoint, text encoder, and VAE, then handles size, steps, guidance, seed, sampler, and scheduler in one place. Use it to switch between portrait, square, and landscape outputs quickly. Keep guidance modest for Krea 2 Turbo, increase steps when chasing micro‑detail, and use batches to explore multiple seeds efficiently. If you apply LoRAs, adjust their strength conservatively to preserve base‑model coherence.

  • CR Text(#8)
    A simple text field for prefix tokens that should always lead your prompt, such as a style tag, brand tag, or LoRA trigger. Keep prefixes short and separated by commas for clean conditioning.

  • CR Text Concatenate(#13)
    Merges the prefix with your main prompt into a single, well‑formed description for the sampler. Use it to enforce consistent phrasing and to test how different prefixes steer the same base prompt.

  • Seed (rgthree)(#7)
    A utility node for generating, locking, or shuffling the seed value that drives randomness. It is the quickest way to reproduce an image later or branch a set of controlled variations.

  • binyuanMultiImageCompare(#3)
    Builds a labeled grid from your outputs for fast A/B review. Use it to annotate runs with a short tag, then evaluate composition, lighting, and texture fidelity across seeds or parameter changes.

  • SaveImage(#20)
    Saves the rendered images to disk with a clear filename prefix. Name runs by project, orientation, or date to keep large explorations organized.
